chapter: Theaters, the Navy and the Singletons' partnership
title: Replacements at the piano: Big Boy and Gene Anderson
summary: Zutty brought in a huge pianist called Big Boy, who later went to Canada; when Big Boy left for an act he got Gene Anderson, formerly of the Carroll Dickerson band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I brought in old Big Boy. Because Andy said, my God, he said, I didn't want you to, a piano player, but you brought me a piano mover. (LAUGHTER).
I've forgotten his name, but he's still around. And he was in Canada, he played a whole lot of piano. A big black guy.
A big cat. He used to play with Bingle Madison's band at the Tango Palace.
Yes. Who was that? Did you say he was from Canada?
The last time I heard about him, I read somewhere he was working in Canada.
Yes. (Lawrence?) he made up an act, he went with an act for a long time. They would just act, stayed with this act a long time. So that's when I got Gene Anderson.
Now Gene Anderson, now was he from Chicago originally?
He's with the Carroll Dickerson band.
Yes, he's still up in Harlem because he just became a lush.
